svg.title: The L, then a plan, from above
svg.desc: An animation, seen from above, of the Lesson 3-3 activity on a 4 by 4 taped grid. In step 1 the robot starts on a segment facing away from you, arrives at two intersections, turns right on the second, and arrives at two more along the crossing line, ending parked on the fourth. In step 2 it follows an example plan from a different start: three intersections, a left turn, one intersection. Beside it, the plan for each run, with the leg or corner being driven highlighted.
svg.text: The L, then a plan, from above
A plan reads like directions, and each
line of it becomes one line of code:
drive_intersections() for a leg, a turn

g.text: Step 2: a plan of your own
one line of code per leg or corner
